title: Client and Training Data Selection for Computationally Efficient Synchronized Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.39250v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a promising paradigm of machine learning, which preserves user privacy by enabling learning without sharing raw data with a cloud server. Straggling clients have been a problem for FL as they introduce delays in aggregating the local models and hence, the convergence of the global model. Therefore, it is important to have a mechanism that ensures fast convergence of the global model as well as good FL participation rate. Another issue for the convergence of a model in FL is the non-independent and identically distributed (non-iid) data across the clients. Prior approaches based on probabilistic client selection do not work well under non-iid data especially when the number of clients is small. We show scenarios where such approaches fail and propose a joint client-training data selection algorithm for fast convergence of FL models. translated_title: 面向计算高效的同步联邦学习的客户端与训练数据选择
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）是一种有前景的机器学习范式，通过无需与云服务器共享原始数据即可进行学习，从而保护用户隐私。掉队客户端一直是联邦学习中的一大难题，因为它们会延迟本地模型的聚合，进而延缓全局模型的收敛。因此，需要一种机制来确保全局模型的快速收敛以及良好的联邦学习参与率。联邦学习中影响模型收敛的另一个问题是客户端之间数据的非独立同分布（non-iid）特性。先前基于概率客户端选择的方法在非独立同分布数据下表现不佳，尤其是在客户端数量较少的情况下。我们展示了此类方法失效的场景，并提出了一种用于实现联邦学习模型快速收敛的客户端-训练数据联合选择算法。我们在CIFAR-100数据集上的实验表明，联邦学习模型的收敛可以……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种客户端与训练数据联合选择算法，解决了基于概率的客户端选择方法在非独立同分布数据且客户端数量较少时失效的问题，从而实现联邦学习模型的快速收敛。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a joint client-training data selection algorithm that overcomes the failure of probabilistic client selection approaches under non-iid data with a small number of clients, achieving fast convergence of federated learning models.
